title: Count overlaps
statement: Count all start positions at which needle occurs in text, including overlapping occurrences. An empty needle occurs at all length(text)+1 boundaries. Exact case-sensitive ASCII comparison.
constraints: All text is ASCII; unless a narrower task bound is stated, each input string has at most 1000 characters.
Preserve the exact declared public types and solve signature. Helpers are allowed.
